name: Petting
overview: Scripture warns that even the inward desire to lust constitutes sin, equating it with adultery in the heart, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:28. This underscores the importance of guarding one's thoughts and actions in all forms of physical affection, including petting, to maintain purity. Galatians 6:7 reminds believers that the consequences of such actions are inevitable, as one reaps what one sows. Ultimately, the revelation of Jesus Christ calls His followers to live in holiness and self-control, anticipating His return as a motivation to honor God in every aspect of life.
